apps.name: Restring Helper
apps.subtitle: Manage stringing orders efficiently.
apps.versionDescription:
WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 3.0

Web Orders Integration:
• Dedicated Web Orders View: A brand new, fully integrated page to track unfulfilled Shopify restring orders.
• Smart Dispatch Tabs: Orders are automatically categorized into "Send Today", "Send Tomorrow", "Pickup", and "All" using a strict 2:00 PM cutoff rule (including weekend logic).
• Auto-Refresh: Automatically pulls fresh data from the server every 10 minutes in the background with a live-ticking status indicator.
• Dashboard UI Parity: Web Orders layout, segmented picker, and order cards match the main Dashboard styling 1-to-1.
• Order Card Enhancements: Tappable phone numbers, product variant details (grip size), customer notes, stencil requirements, and clean order numbers.

Stringer Credit System:
• Team Roster: Configure your stringing team roster directly in Settings.
• Attribution Popup: Prompts a "Who strung this racket?" modal upon completing orders to assign credit.
• Analytics Leaderboard: Live leaderboard tracking rackets strung per team member.
• Secure Reset: Easily reset local history and credit logs in Settings when needed.

Quality of Life & UI Polish:
• Undo Toast: 5-second "Undo" toast after completing orders to revert accidental checkoffs.
• iPad Multitasking: Full support for native Split View and Slide Over on iPadOS.
• App Icon Badges: Dynamic badge showing orders due today and tomorrow.
• Faster Workflow: Removed redundant confirmation alerts for rapid checkoffs.
• Dynamic Empty States: Contextual placeholder messages per tab.

Editing & Workflow Toggles:
• Free Restring Toggle: Locks string selection to "Wilson Sensation - FREE".
• New Racket Toggle: Hides pricing from dashboard and printed labels.
• Unsaved Changes Protection: Prompts a warning before discarding edits.
• Order Context Menu: Restored "Select" option in long-press menu.

Printer & Backend Improvements:
• Printer Tweaks: Guaranteed notes printing on ZPL labels and persistent Zebra connection.
• Backend Sync: Robust null handling for Shopify checkouts, auto-cancellation sync, and customer deduplication.
